description: Haltestellen ZVBN Land Bremen is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The data includes the bus stops and tram stops in the catchment area of the Zweckverband Verkehrsverbund Bremen/Niedersachsen. The data comes from the stop information system HIS of the Zweckverband Verkehrsverbund Bremen/Niedersachsen (ZVBN). Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Stations ZVBN Land Bremen" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2023-09-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
